newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan seamen strike to protest leader's death.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan seamen strike to protest leader's death.

text.p: Thousands of Moroccan seamen started a 48-hour strike on Tuesday in the southern port town of Agadir to protest against what they described as the murder of a leading trade union activist, a union spokesman said.

Abdellah Monacer, 38, secretary-general of the Agadir fishermen's union, was found dead in the sea off Agadir "with severe injuries and marks of criminal torture on his body", a spokesman for the umbrella Moroccan Labour Union (UMT) told Reuters.

"Thousands of seamen and maritime fishery officers went on a 48-hour strike in Agadir on Tuesday to protest against the murder of Monacer and also for the seamen's right to belong to a trade union," the spokesman added.
Monacer's body was found on Saturday floating in the Atlantic off Agadir four days after he disappeared.
